title: Coping (copings/items/<id>/coping.json)
description: What caps a low wall or a retaining wall, as the house view lays it along the top of the wall, whatever the wall is faced with: flat stones, a course of bricks on edge, tiles, a folded metal sheet. Its texture is painted from a few numbers, like the surface of a path, and seen on its top and on its edges.

surface.description: What the coping is made of. A row of its units runs along the wall: the depth of a row, across the wall, comes first in `cell`, then the length of a unit along the wall. A row deeper than the coping is wide gives one unit across the wall (a brick on edge, a slab), with no joint running along it.

height.description: Height of the coping above the top of the wall, in metres.

overhang.description: How far it juts out on each side of the wall, in metres.

drop.description: How far its edges come down over the faces of the wall, in metres: the folded edges of a metal coping. 0 for a coping that is simply laid on top.
